blocks.text: What actually affects the price in 2027?

content.text: Six things decide what you end up paying. Understanding them is what stops you from buying too little, or far too much.

Shared hosting is the cheapest because many websites share one server and its cost. VPS hosting gives your website its own guaranteed CPU, RAM and storage, so it costs more. Cloud hosting sits above shared hosting and is built for websites that need room to grow. The type matters more than any other factor. If you are unsure between shared and VPS, read our
shared vs VPS comparison

A small blog and a busy online store do not need the same server. More CPU cores, more RAM and more SSD storage cost more. On VPS plans this is exactly what separates the Rs 1,699 plan (1 CPU core, 2 GB RAM, 40 GB SSD) from the Rs 4,999 plan (2 CPU cores, 8 GB RAM, 160 GB SSD). Buy for the traffic you realistically expect in the next year, not for traffic you hope to have one day.

SSL (the padlock in the browser) is now essential, for security and for search rankings. Some providers charge extra for it every year. ZedgeHost includes a free SSL certificate with every hosting plan, so it is not an added cost here. Whenever you compare providers, check whether SSL is included or billed separately. Our guide explains
why every Pakistani business website needs SSL
and what free SSL covers.

Backups protect you when an update breaks something or a file is deleted by mistake. Website migration matters if you already have a website somewhere else and want to move it without downtime. ZedgeHost includes weekly backups and free website migration, and both are worth checking with any provider before you buy. Our guide covers
moving your website to a new host without downtime

With many providers, the price on the sales page is an introductory price and the renewal price is higher. Domains are the clearest example: a .com costs Rs 2,999 in the first year at ZedgeHost and renews at Rs 3,999 per year. Hosting plans renew at their listed yearly price. Always confirm what you will pay next year, and what happens if you pay monthly instead of yearly, before you enter your payment details. Ask the question before you pay, with any provider, including us.

When a website goes down at midnight, support is the product. ZedgeHost includes 24/7 expert support with its plans. Cheap hosting with no reachable support usually costs more in the end, in lost visitors and lost time.

blocks.text: Which type should you choose for 2027?

content.text: Best for a first website, a personal blog, a portfolio or a small business website. You get cPanel, free SSL, weekly backups and local payment options, and you do not need to manage a server. Most new websites in Pakistan start here, and you can upgrade later when traffic grows.

Best if your website runs on WordPress. It is shared hosting tuned for WordPress, with one-click installs and the same included extras. If you are building a blog, a news site or a business site on WordPress, start here rather than on generic shared hosting. Our step-by-step guide shows
how to start a WordPress blog in Pakistan

Best for growing websites and online stores that need more power and headroom than shared hosting offers, without managing a server yourself. Cloud plans run from Rs 9,999 to Rs 25,000 per year. If your shared plan starts feeling slow during busy hours, cloud hosting is the natural next step. Read
what cloud hosting is and when you need it
before you decide.

Best when you need full control: root access, your own guaranteed resources, and the freedom to install what you want. Developers, agencies hosting client websites, and high-traffic websites usually land on VPS. ZedgeHost VPS plans run from Rs 1,699 to Rs 4,999 per month, with yearly billing also available, and you can choose your server location (New Jersey, Los Angeles or Dallas) and operating system (AlmaLinux, Ubuntu, Debian, or an empty disk) at checkout.

blocks.text: How to budget for hosting in 2027

items.text: One small website with modest traffic fits shared or WordPress hosting. Several websites, or one busy website, points toward cloud or VPS.
Add Rs 2,999 for a .com in year one (Rs 3,999 on renewal) or Rs 4,999 for a .pk covering two years. Business and Enterprise hosting include a free .com for the first year.
Pick the smallest plan that honestly covers your needs today. Upgrading later is easy; paying for idle resources is not refunded time.
SSL, backups, cPanel, migration and support should be in the price, not added at checkout. Compare the full list, not just the headline number.
Know what you will pay next year, and whether yearly billing saves you anything, before you enter your payment details.
ZedgeHost bills in PKR and accepts Easypaisa, JazzCash, Raast and bank transfer, so there are no currency conversion surprises. Our guide explains
